SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'trigger',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'internal',t.tgisinternal,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid),'function_schema',pn.nspname,'function',p.proname,'function_identity',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'body_md5',md5(p.prosrc),'mentions_capacity_kids',p.prosrc~*'capacity_kids','mentions_capacity_children',p.prosrc~*'capacity_children','mentions_received_at',p.prosrc~*'received_at','mentions_revision',p.prosrc~*'revision','mentions_created_at',p.prosrc~*'created_at','mentions_updated_at',p.prosrc~*'updated_at') ORDER BY c.relname,t.tgname) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND c.relname IN ('rooms','rates','hotels_master','tariffs_master','seasons','seasons_master','hotel_policies')) AS triggers,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'function',p.proname,'identity',pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid),'language',l.lanname,'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'body_md5',md5(p.prosrc),'mentions_rates',p.prosrc~*'\mrates\M','mentions_insert',p.prosrc~*'\minsert\M','mentions_update',p.prosrc~*'\mupdate\M','mentions_received_at',p.prosrc~*'received_at','mentions_revision',p.prosrc~*'revision','mentions_capacity_kids',p.prosrc~*'capacity_kids','mentions_capacity_children',p.prosrc~*'capacity_children') ORDER BY p.proname,p.oid) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.prokind='f' AND (p.proname='ingestar_tarifa_proveedor' OR p.proname LIKE 'core1%' OR (p.prosrc~*'(insert[[:space:]]+into|update)[[:space:]]+(public\.)?rates\M'))) AS writer_candidates,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'relation',c.relname) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='supabase_migrations' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p')) AS migration_catalog_relations;

WITH candidates AS (SELECT c.oid,n.nspname,c.relname,c.relkind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m') AND (c.relname ~* '(room.*(occup|synonym)|hotel_profiles|rate.*snapshot|snapshot.*rate)'))
SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,
(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',nspname,'relation',relname,'kind',relkind) ORDER BY relname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM candidates) AS relations,
(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.table_name,'column',c.column_name,'type',c.data_type,'udt',c.udt_name,'nullable',c.is_nullable,'default',c.column_default) ORDER BY c.table_name,c.ordinal_position),'[]'::jsonb) FROM information_schema.columns c JOIN candidates x ON x.nspname=c.table_schema AND x.relname=c.table_name) AS columns,
(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',x.relname,'constraint',k.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid)) ORDER BY x.relname,k.conname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_constraint k JOIN candidates x ON x.oid=k.conrelid) AS constraints,
(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',x.relname,'trigger',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)) ORDER BY x.relname,t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN candidates x ON x.oid=t.tgrelid WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal) AS triggers;
